## Summary & Expertise
Saipavan Veeravalli is a full-stack engineer with 3+ years of professional experience and 2+ years of freelancing (close to 60 client projects). He started with Telegram bots and HTML games in 2015, built 10+ Google AdSense-approved WordPress sites with up to 2 million monthly visits (strong SEO background), and moved into development in 2021 with the MERN stack. Today he builds SaaS products, AI agents, MCP servers and automation workflows with Next.js, Node.js (Fastify, NestJS), TypeScript and PostgreSQL. He qualified GATE and runs two SaaS products of his own.

## Technical Skills
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js (App Router, Server Actions, SSR/SSG), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Material UI, Redux.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Fastify, NestJS, GraphQL, Express.js, RESTful API Design, Authentication & Authorization, Web Scraping, Cron Jobs, Java Backend.
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Prisma.
- **AI & Automation:** AI agents, AI automation workflows, MCP servers, LLM integrations.
- **Tools & Platforms:** Git, GitHub, Docker, AWS, Vercel, Resend, WordPress, Postman.
- **SEO & Performance:** Technical SEO, On-Page Optimization, Structured Data (JSON-LD), Core Web Vitals, Caching Strategies.

## Featured Projects

- **BugRadar** (new)
  - Description: AI-assisted bug tracking and client feedback SaaS. A website widget and extension let QA teams and clients log issues directly, with AI-generated titles, priorities and debugging hints, real-time collaboration, role-based access control and multi-organization support. A Chrome extension is in development.
  - Tech Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Socket.IO.
  - Demo: [http://bugrader.site/](http://bugrader.site/)

- **CompressByURL**
  - Description: Browser-first image compression platform that scans a webpage and compresses all its images in one go using Web Workers and WebAssembly, so files never leave the device. Ships an MCP server (compressbyurl-mcp on npm) for AI agents and CI image-size budgets.
  - Tech Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, WebAssembly, Web Workers, Node.js, MCP.
  - Demo: [https://compressbyurl.com/](https://compressbyurl.com/)
  - Repository: [https://github.com/im-shadowpool/compressbyurl](https://github.com/im-shadowpool/compressbyurl)

- **Admin Dashboard**
  - Description: Full-stack admin dashboard for e-commerce analytics, real-time revenue tracking, product and user management, transactions, and geographic data visualization.
  - Tech Stack: React, Material UI, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB.
  - Demo: [https://admin-dashboard-ten-nu-63.vercel.app/dashboard](https://admin-dashboard-ten-nu-63.vercel.app/dashboard)
  - Repository: [https://github.com/im-shadowpool/admin-dashboard](https://github.com/im-shadowpool/admin-dashboard)

- **Sticky Docs**
  - Description: Interactive note-taking and document management web application featuring draggable cards, color categorization, customizable themes, and full CRUD database persistence.
  - Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, REST API.
  - Demo: [https://sticky-docs.vercel.app/](https://sticky-docs.vercel.app/)
  - Repository: [https://github.com/im-shadowpool/Sticky-Docs](https://github.com/im-shadowpool/Sticky-Docs)

- **DealsTracker**
  - Description: E-commerce price tracking and deals discovery platform aggregating real-time prices from Amazon and Flipkart with price drop alerts, historical trend charts, automated web scraping, and cron jobs.
  - Tech Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Web Scraping, Cron Jobs.
  - Demo: [https://dealstracker.vercel.app/](https://dealstracker.vercel.app/)
  - Repository: [https://github.com/im-shadowpool/dealstracker](https://github.com/im-shadowpool/dealstracker)

- **RiteBlog App**
  - Description: Full-featured blogging platform with user authentication, role-based authorization, image uploads, dynamic article creation, and rich text editing.
  - Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, REST API.
